capabilities: mark speakable sections with data-speak-out attributes or speak: marker links
play marked text with a speaker button in reading view
choose speech engine, voice, and language in settings
preview selected voices from the settings tab
extras: Playback is local only; the README states it makes no network requests, though some platform voices may be cloud-backed. Controls appear only in reading view, not source view.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play selected note passages aloud or to mark which parts of a note should be spoken.
summary: Text-to-speech plugin that adds speaker buttons in reading view for note sections marked with HTML data attributes or marker links.
